chain_augmentations: apply a sequence of data augmentation functions to a MiniBatch example
normalize_image: normalize an image to 3 channels and convert pixel values to the -1 to 1 range
random_crop_and_resize: randomly sample a distorted crop from an image and resize it to a target size
central_crop_and_resize: extract the central region of an image and resize it to a specified size
random_flip_image: randomly flip an image left to right as a data augmentation step
